claims.text: The programme schedules the 'Traditional Installation Ceremony of His Majesty King George Tupou V - Taumafa Kava' at Mala'e Pangai at 10:00 on Wednesday 30 July 2008.
claims.uncertainty: A prospective schedule, not a post-event report; the installation's occurrence is recorded by to_crown_gtv_taumafa_kava_held_20080730, which names the venue Pangai Lahi. The traditional installation is distinct from the 2006 accession and from the church coronation.

claims.text: The programme schedules 'THE CORONATION OF HIS MAJESTY KING GEORGE TUPOU V' at the Free Wesleyan Centenary Church, Kolomotu'a, at 10:00 on Friday 1 August 2008, followed at 13:00 by a Royal Luncheon hosted by the Prime Minister.
claims.uncertainty: A prospective schedule; occurrence is corroborated by to_crown_gtv_coronation_day_address_20080801 and to_crown_gtv_coronation_guests_20080801. The coronation is not the start of the reign.
